notes.title: "The Heist" - Check Out the First Gameplay Trailer
notes.content:
Hey Steam fans! In our first dev diary, we'd like to share news about [b]new screenshots and the first gameplay trailer[/b] of our upcoming game "The Heist," a narrative-driven cyberpunk noir interactive comic. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4x4_oidI7-Q

The gameplay trailer and the new screenshots reveal a glimpse of [b]playable locations on Ganymede[/b], one of the flourishing Jupiter's moons, as well as cyberspace in which one part of the game is set.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34944908/aad7c500eb8101622a2e3acb01028f93138956cf.png[/img]

[b]Glamorous Ganymede[/b] - Ganymede is situated in the richest and most orderly sector of the colonized System, but there is trouble brewing beneath its perfect façade. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34944908/390c7a66c20bf1b8c8fd0526c2e578f8885002d6.png[/img]

[b]Exclusive Gala[/b] - Wealthy politicians and owners of rich corporations spend their free time oblivious to the troubles of the poor. To relieve themselves of existential boredom, they throw excessive parties and organize costly balls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34944908/592ac90e15c1629e7ad2c65f38d4be5a499ed519.png[/img]

[b]Yusein-Takeda Corporation[/b] - Our protagonists are trying to steal a technological prototype from a research facility that belongs to the Yusein-Takeda corporation, one of the most influential corporations in the System. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34944908/d77e36e51c2b2c814b9d034944b94d28020e8db9.png[/img]

[b]Cyberspace[/b] - There are two types of reality in the universe of Sol Invictus: the physical reality and cyberspace. The dangers are very real and very deadly in both of them. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34944908/8f8f32dfa4171bb4d49be87d11ff821652e5a0d9.png[/img]

[b]Difficult Decisions and Multiple Endings[/b] - The player will have to make difficult decisions and each of them will have a ripple effect on the outcome of the story. There are multiple possible endings based on the player’s decisions, which gives the game a substantial and varied replay value. 

We can’t wait to share more details with you about the game’s world, story, visual art and gameplay, so stay tuned to our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1065860/The_Heist/]Steam page[/url] for our next dev diary when we’ll [b]dive into the world of Sol Invictus[/b]. ;) 

(You can also wishlist the game on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1065860/The_Heist/]Steam[/url], follow news about "The Heist" on [url=https://www.facebook.com/gamechuckdev/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/gamechuckdev]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/gamechuckdev/]Instagram[/url] and chat with all of us on [url=https://discord.gg/GF3PRKm]Discord[/url].)
